name: Dogmatika Punishment
card_text: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; send 1 monster with an equal or higher ATK from your Extra Deck to the GY, and if you do, destroy that monster. Until the end of your next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck. You can only activate 1 "Dogmatika Punishment" per turn.
